description_en: Queries a list of live stream recording jobs by page
description_zh: 调用ListLiveRecordJobs获取实时录制任务列表，可分页获取
kebab_example: aliyun ice list-live-record-jobs --keyword ab0e3e76-1e9d-11ed-ba64-0c42a1b73d66 --start-time 2022-07-15T08:00:00Z --end-time 2022-07-11T08:00:00Z --status started --page-no 1 --page-size 20 --sort-by desc --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListLiveRecordJobs

parameters.description_en: The search keyword. You can use the job ID or name as the keyword to search for jobs.
parameters.description_zh: 搜索关键词，可以根据任务ID和名称搜索。
parameters.help_en: The search keyword. You can use the job ID or name as the keyword to search for jobs
parameters.help_zh: 搜索关键词，可以根据任务ID和名称搜索
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.description_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
parameters.description_zh: 查询开始时间。格式为yyyy-mm-ddthh:mm:ssz（UTC时间）。
parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式为yyyy-mm-ddthh:mm:ssz（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.description_en: The end of the time range to query. The maximum time range between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed 30 days. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
parameters.description_zh: 查询结束时间，与StartTime相差不超过30天。格式为yyyy-mm-ddthh:mm:ssz（UTC时间）。
parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The maximum time range between EndTime and StartTime cannot exceed 30 days. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，与StartTime相差不超过30天。格式为yyyy-mm-ddthh:mm:ssz（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.description_en:
The state of the job. By default, the state is not filtered.

Valid values:

- paused: The job is paused.

- initial: The job is not started.

- started: The job is in progress.
parameters.description_zh: 任务状态。默认不过滤状态。
parameters.help_en:
The state of the job. By default, the state is not filtered.

Valid values:

- paused: The job is paused.

- initial: The job is not started.

- started: The job is in progress
parameters.help_zh: 任务状态。默认不过滤状态
parameters.name: status

parameters.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.
parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description_en:
The sorting order. By default, the query results are sorted by creation time in descending order.

Valid values:

- asc: sorts the query results in ascending order.

- desc: sorts the query results in descending order.
parameters.description_zh: 排序参数，默认按创建时间倒序。
parameters.help_en:
The sorting order. By default, the query results are sorted by creation time in descending order.

parameters.help_zh: 排序参数，默认按创建时间倒序
parameters.name: sort_by
